framings.text: A self-compounding, human-first experience where you act as the final judge, receiving a delicious, durable result that makes the next change easier while considering the whole codebase.

supports.quote: system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.
not just the trees, but the forest.

framings.text: A coordinated path from an initial hunch or prompt to a PR ready for human review, with rigor, verification, and codebase health carried through the work.

supports.quote: a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human

outcome: You can bring an intuition and later encounter a coherent, verified, durable result at the human review point—one that respects the whole codebase, tastes right to you as final judge, and makes its next change easier.

questions.text: Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the harness improves its own way of working, the codebase becomes easier to change, or both?

alternatives.label: Self-improving harness first
alternatives.benefit: Could make future work increasingly coherent and effective across projects.
alternatives.cost: The codebase’s immediate health and changeability may receive less emphasis.

alternatives.label: Codebase health first
alternatives.benefit: Could more directly produce review-ready changes that improve future maintainability.
alternatives.cost: The harness’s own compounding may remain less developed.
